isTriggerChangeOnOptionClick.description: Determines whether changes are triggered in real-time upon clicking an option

label.description: Sets the label of filter, shown both when closed and open

multiple.description: Defines whether multiple selections or can be made from the filter simultaneously or only one

onChange.description: Function to set what happens when a new value is set via the filter

search.description: Provides a search bar at the top of the filter from which users can narrow the list of menu items
